reviews.summary: Reviewed the patch and gave a Reviewed-by tag, indicating that it meets kernel coding standards.
reviews.raw_body:
On Wed, Oct 28, 2026 at 10:20 AM Dmitry Ilvokhin <d@ilvokhin.com> wrote:
>
> Commit 22302af28d3f ("cleanup: Annotate guard constructors with
> nonnull") added the macro __nonnull_args() to wrap raw compiler
> attribute.
>
> Replace __attribute__((nonnull)) with __nonnull_args() to standardize
> nonnull attribute usage across the tree and keep the attribute's quirks
> in one place rather than open-coded at every call site.

Reviewed-by: Andy Shevchenko <andy@kernel.org>

-- 
With Best Regards,
Andy Shevchenko

2026-10-28.patch_summary: This patch series standardizes the use of the __nonnull_args() macro across the kernel tree by replacing raw compiler attributes at call sites.

2026-10-29.patch_summary: This patch series aims to standardize the use of the __nonnull_args() macro across the kernel tree, replacing raw compiler attributes at individual call sites.
